definitions.explanation: A formal decision made through discussion and voting in an assembly, parliament, board meeting, or other deliberative body.

examples.japanese: {予算案|よさんあん}が{議決|ぎけつ}された。
examples.english: The budget proposal was passed by vote.

examples.japanese: {取締役会|とりしまりやくかい}の{議決|ぎけつ}を{経|へ}て{実行|じっこう}する。
examples.english: It will be implemented after approval by the board of directors.

examples.japanese: {法案|ほうあん}は{賛成|さんせい}{多数|たすう}で{議決|ぎけつ}され、{来月|らいげつ}から{施行|しこう}される{見込|みこ}みだ。
examples.english: The bill was passed by a majority vote and is expected to take effect next month.

notes:
USAGE:
{議決|ぎけつ} is a formal term used in legislative, corporate governance, and organizational contexts. It implies a deliberative process followed by a formal vote.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {議決|ぎけつ}する (to pass a resolution, to vote on)
- {議決|ぎけつ}を{経|へ}る (to go through a vote)
- {議決|ぎけつ}{権|けん} (voting rights)
- {全会一致|ぜんかいいっち}で{議決|ぎけつ}する (to pass unanimously)
- {議決|ぎけつ}{事項|じこう} (matters to be voted on)
